patient.title: Patient Record
patient.description: Patient clinical biological baseline tracking details.

id.description: Standard identifier for patient, e.g. PA-XXX

vitals.description: Comma-separated or formatted clinical vitals string representation.

notes.description: Textual clinical notes or observation logs. Is strictly confidential.

ownerId.description: Firebase Authentication User ID representing the owner/creator clinician.

lat.description: Geolocational latitude of the patient cohort location.

lon.description: Geolocational longitude of the patient cohort location.

createdAt.description: Firebase ServerTimestamp recorded at initial composition.

auditLog.title: Clinical Audit Log
auditLog.description: Confidential activity log entries generated inside Stratum Workspace runner.

logText.description: Text formatting representing standard trace or GitLab orchestration messages.

ownerId.description: The UID of the clinician executing operations or receiving the log stream.

createdAt.description: ServerTimestamp identifying the precise event timeline.

/patients/{patientId}.description: Secure access to patient biomarker histories, keyed by unique generated ID.

/logs/{logId}.description: Internal developer runner outputs and clinician audit trails synchronized to Firestore database.
